subset_transformation: Read interval ZIPs in ascending filename order; keep the first I,DISPATCH,UNIT_SCADA header and every original D,DISPATCH,UNIT_SCADA line with a selected DUID. Preserve original line bytes, numeric strings and LASTCHANGED. No C report envelopes are included because this file is a multi-report subset. No measurements are generated or altered.
timestamp_convention: SETTLEMENTDATE is the native dispatch label in fixed AEST (UTC+10), with no daylight saving. Labels range from 00:05 on the selected NEM day through 00:00 on the next day.
measurement_convention: Instantaneous SCADA MW at the start of the dispatch interval, not average power or settlement energy.
attribution: Source: Australian Energy Market Operator (AEMO), NEMWeb. This repository does not alter the source data rights; consult AEMO terms before redistributing larger datasets.
